claim: Moor Hall is located at Prescot Road, Aughton, Lancashire, L39 6RT, in a Grade II*-listed mid-16th-century house with five acres of gardens.
quote: Moor Hall Restaurant, Prescot Road, Aughton, Lancashire, L39 6RT … sited in a secluded but convenient location close to the ancient market town of Ormskirk.

claim: Moor Hall holds three Michelin stars and five AA Rosettes and has 14 bedrooms across the main house, gatehouse, and Garden Rooms.
quote: three Michelin star Restaurant with fourteen unique, luxurious bedrooms

claim: Moor Hall room rates: Gatehouse from £275, Main House from £300–£425, Garden Rooms from £450–£500 per night.
quote: Elderberry: From £275/night … Rosehip: From £300/night … Mulberry: From £425/night … Sea Buckthorn: From £450/night … Anise Hyssop: From £500/night

claim: Five of Moor Hall's bedrooms are in the main hall, two in the gatehouse by the lake, and seven Garden Rooms are set in the grounds; rooms start at £270 B&B.
quote: fourteen unique luxurious guest bedrooms, five are located in the main hall and two are located in the gatehouse situated by the lake, with a further seven Garden Rooms set in the grounds of Moor Hall. … Rooms start at £270.00 for bed & breakfast.

claim: The seven Garden Rooms are prefabricated Koto cabins (Scandinavian timber, outdoor hot tubs) installed in the Moor Hall grounds and opened in July 2024.
quote: 7 cabins were delivered in Phase 1 … opened in July 2024 … modern Scandinavian design, sustainability, and high-end comfort

claim: The Garden Rooms are named after botanicals — Melilot, Sea Buckthorn, Woodruff, Sweet Cicely, Oxalis, Borage and Anise Hyssop.
quote: Named Melilot, Sea Buckthorn, Woodruff, Sweet Cicely, Oxalis, Borage and Anise Hyssop

claim: The Borage Garden Room has Scandinavian-feel design, huge windows, an outdoor hot tub, and Pelegrims toiletries.
quote: Ours was Borage and had a very Scandi feel with huge windows, lots of natural light, a muted colour scheme … There's an outdoor hot tub, powerful shower and a nice touch of UK-based Pelegrims product

claim: Reviewer rates rooms inclusive of breakfast and VAT and notes that staying overnight is significantly more enjoyable than day-tripping; Town Green station is a 15-minute walk from the restaurant.
quote: staying over is a lot more fun … the nearest train station to the restaurant, Town Green which is described as a very easy 15-minute walk

claim: West Tower (Mill Lane, L39 7HJ) is 1.4 miles from Moor Hall and Birches Brow Boutique Guestrooms (Formby Lane, L39 7HG) is 1.6 miles — the only two hotels Tripadvisor lists within 2 miles.
quote: West Tower — Distance: 1.4 miles … Mill Lane, Ormskirk L39 7HJ … Birches Brow Boutique Guestrooms — Distance: 1.6 miles … Birches Brow Formby Lane, Aughton, Ormskirk L39 7HG

claim: Birches Brow is an 18-th-century house with eight boutique guestrooms; breakfast is delivered to the room as a basket; one minute from West Tower and five minutes' drive from Ormskirk centre.
quote: eight boutique guest rooms … breakfast … a wonderful basket, packed full of delicious goodies … one minute from the award winning West Tower wedding venue and a five minute drive from Ormskirk

claim: Birches Brow guests report £4.50 taxis to Moor Hall and the owners (Steve) offer lifts; the property is rated #2 of 2 B&Bs in Aughton, 4.5/5 from 126 reviews.
quote: taxi from Birches Brow to Moor Hall costs £4.50 … Steve even gave us a lift to Moor Hall on the Saturday morning to collect our car

claim: West Tower is a country-house wedding venue at Mill Lane, Aughton L39 7HJ, rated 4.8/5 on Tripadvisor (413 reviews); one of the most-booked hotels in Aughton.
quote: West Tower … Mill Lane, Aughton, L39 7HJ … 4.8 of 5 bubbles (413 reviews) … one of the most booked hotels in Aughton over the last 60 days

claim: Miller & Carter Aughton by Innkeeper's Collection is at Springfield Road, Aughton, L39 6ST — about 1.5 miles from Moor Hall.
quote: Miller & Carter, Springfield Road, Aughton, L39 6ST, Ormskirk, United Kingdom

claim: The Innkeeper's Collection Aughton is positioned in the village of Aughton with a Miller & Carter steakhouse on-site and is within walking distance of Town Green railway station.
quote: Innkeeper's Lodge Ormskirk Aughton is within walking distance of Town Green Railway Station

claim: Town Green is a Merseyrail Northern Line station in Aughton with regular trains to Liverpool Central and Ormskirk.
quote: Town Green railway station … Merseyrail Northern Line

claim: Moor Hall is close to local footpaths; an 8.5-mile circular walk along the Liverpool–Leeds Canal starts one mile from the restaurant, and Formby Beach, Southport, and Liverpool are ~25–30 minutes by car.
quote: Moor Hall is also situated close to a number of pleasant footpaths and other trails … 8.5 mile circular walk begins one mile from the restaurant, incorporating the Liverpool Leeds Canal

claim: Michelin Guide lists Moor Hall as a three-star restaurant in Aughton, Lancashire.
quote: Moor Hall – Aughton – a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant
